text:
Drew Morales: Heads up — Vela Systems (reseller) asked for an onboarding package: 12-month prepaid commit of $120k credits, 25% rev-share on gross, and a 20% reseller discount on seat pricing for the first 6 months. They also want net-45 invoicing. Need finance + legal sign-off on the revenue treatment and payout flow. cc @Sarah Patel @Alex Chang

Alex Chang: Quick Qs — is this hosted or dedicated? Also please drop expected ARR / run-rate and an estimate for COGS. We need that to sign off on the reseller discount and rev-share reserve.

Drew Morales: Hosted API. Expected booked commit $120k prepaid credits -> recognized monthly over 12 months. Post-onboard estimated ARR ~ $180k (conservative). Rough COGS estimate ~$28k for infra + support over year. They want rev-share paid monthly out of collected usage.

Drew Morales: Sample invoice lines they propose:
```
Invoice Line A: Prepaid Credits (12 mo) - $120,000
Invoice Line B: Reseller discount applied (20% for 6 mo) - tracked per-seat
Payout flow: Monthly usage -> Redwood collects -> reserve % for rev-share -> payout to reseller monthly.
```

Sarah Patel: From accounting side: prepaid recognition monthly is fine. We'll record Deferred Revenue (2100) and recognize to Revenue (4001) monthly. Need to create a Reseller Payout liability account (5105) to hold reserve. Also need to know if rev-share is gross or net (before or after platform fees).

Rana Singh: Legal: we'll need an addendum to the channel reseller agreement to capture rev-share mechanics, tax responsibilities, and confidentiality/privacy clauses (no redistribution of PII). I can draft the addendum if commercial terms are locked. Also flag: indemnity carve-outs for data handling.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4823: "Vela reseller pricing & rev-share setup" — billing flow requires new plan id, invoice template, and mapping to GL codes. Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/BILL-4823

Alex Chang: OK — a couple of guardrails before formal approval: (1) confirm source of the COGS estimate (who on infra signed off?), (2) define cap on rev-share (suggest we cap at 40% of gross margin to protect ops). If those are acceptable I can approve the one-off discount + net-45. @Sarah please confirm reserve percentage.

Sarah Patel: Confirmed with treasury: exposure under $150k looks OK for net-45. We will reserve 25% of prepaid as rev-share liability and reconcile monthly against actual usage/payouts. Approving special terms: 20% reseller discount (first 6 months), net-45 billing, prepaid credits recognition monthly, and rev-share reserve at 25%. :white_check_mark:

Drew Morales: :tada: Thanks team — Rana, can you loop in Partnerships for the addendum review? I'll attach Vela's SOW to BILL-4823. billing-bot, please tag the ticket with plan id 'vela-reseller-v1' and queue for config.

billing-bot: Updated BILL-4823 with plan tag 'vela-reseller-v1' and attached invoice template draft. Next steps: legal signoff -> billing config -> create customer credit account -> schedule monthly payout workflow. ETA 2-3 business days for initial config.
